The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu graced the first convocation of AIIMS Bilaspur in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, on October 6, 2026.
The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu received H.E. Mr Guy Parmelin, President of the Swiss Confederation at Rashtrapati Bhavan on October 5, 2026.

The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu launched Brahma Kumaris’ campaign ‘Spiritual Awakening for World Renewal’ and inaugurated the ‘Global Spiritual Palace’ Retreat Centre at Vadodara, Gujarat on September 23, 2026.
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu graced the 75th annual convocation ceremony of the Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda at Vadodara, Gujarat on September 23, 2026.

ProfileHon’ble President of India , Smt. Droupadi Murmu
Smt. Droupadi Murmu was sworn in as the 15th President of India on 25 July, 2022. Previously, she was the Governor of Jharkhand from 2015 to 2021.
She has devoted her life to empowering the downtrodden as well as the marginalised sections of society and deepening the democratic values.
